## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List checks run and their results, or explain why checks do not apply.
Include manual validation where automated checks are not available.

## Compatibility

Describe breaking changes, migration steps, or write "None".

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR targets `main`, or the appropriate maintenance branch for an older-version fix.
- [ ] The change is focused and ready for review.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests are updated, where applicable.
- [ ] Validation results are recorded above.
